analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일간 RSI 58.3 → 60.6 → 61.5 상승 추세 유지, Higher Low 패턴 지속. MACD 히스토그램은 5.5293 → 3.7151로 악화되었으나, RSI가 여전히 60선을 상회하며 상승 추세 지지. ADX 16.8로 추세 미형성 구간이나, 5일 평균 대비 거래량 1.15배로 움직임에 힘 실림. 스윙 지지선 150.08 상회.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI has maintained an uptrend from 58.3 to 61.5 over the past 3 sessions, with the Higher Low pattern continuing. Although the MACD histogram has worsened from 5.5293 to 3.7151, the RSI remains above 60, supporting the uptrend. ADX is at 16.8, indicating a non-trending phase, but the volume ratio of 1.15x the 5-day average adds conviction to the move. Price is above the swing support at $150.08.
